title: Shared Struggle
coreMove: Enter the burden with others so the cost becomes mutual instead of displaced.
sourcePressure: Shows that difficulty deepens trust when burden is mutual, visible, and protected, while rejecting abuse, arbitrary harshness, and outsourced strain.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Romanticizing suffering, hazing, or hardship as inherently bonding.

counterintuition: numbers versus people as a flat binary
